data.title: 春日野穹 · 缘侧的麦茶与零食
data.description: 老家缘侧，她盘腿坐着，面前摊着 Pocky、薯片和倒好的麦茶，笔记本放在膝上看视频；电风扇摇头吹过她的长发，是无聊又安心的夏日午后。
data.action: 老家缘侧，她盘腿坐着，面前摊着 Pocky、薯片和倒好的麦茶，笔记本放在膝上看视频
data.promptProse: Sora Kasugano sits cross-legged on the old house's veranda, watching a laptop on her knees while Pocky, chips and barley tea spread before her. A turning electric fan lifts her long white hair above the cream sweater and grey trousers. The horizontal medium view includes the garden beyond the eaves. Shaded afternoon light gently reveals the snack wrappers and screen-side face, with brighter garden reflections edging the veranda boards.
